summary: Projected the rewritten ESSENCE (pillar 1, most-abstract model) into canonical state and completed the first implementation batch. Spec: S-001..S-018 (must, from 必須対応事項/成功条件/前提事項) and S-019..S-022 (should, from 任意対応事項). Todo: T-001..T-013 (must) following the 遂行順序 phases, T-014..T-017 (should). Executed T-001+T-002: created src/domain (pure domain layer — types.ts, blockTree.ts, view.ts, validatorSet.ts, index.ts) with reference types View/Vote/Block, anchor block at slot 0 (sentinel parent/proposer -1), immutable BlockTree with ancestry/leaf queries, validator count 4..10 default 4, plus tests incl. a mechanical import-purity test. Evidence: npm run typecheck exit 0, npm test exit 0 (13 files / 100 tests), npm run build exit 0. Decisions: (1) keep Vite+React+TS stack (Essence delegates stack choice); (2) leave M1 code in place until phase2 UI replacement so the build gate stays green — the discard premise is honored by replacement, not by an up-front delete; (3) anchor-at-slot-0 / first-proposal-at-slot-1 interpretation recorded in the handoff for human visibility. No Essence ambiguity blocking progress; no high-risk paths touched.

Executed batch T-003+T-004 (phase1-core, cost 8). T-003: protocol skeleton in src/domain — forkChoice.ts (LMD latest-vote selection with order-independent same-slot equivocation tie-break, GHOST subtree weights, deterministic smallest-index tie-break), finality.ts (SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4 minimal epoch notion, checkpointFor with empty-boundary-slot fallback, supermajority=ceil(2n/3), justification fixpoint from the anchor, adjacent-epoch 1-finality), protocol.ts (round-robin proposer schedule, buildProposal on the GHOST head, buildAttestation with source=justified checkpoint / target=current-epoch checkpoint). T-004: simulation.ts — SimulationConfig{validatorCount, seed}, advanceSlot (propose, all validators attest, recompute finality and heads), stateAtSlot as pure recomputation from the anchor, which IS the rewind path. Evidence: npm run typecheck exit 0, npm test exit 0 (16 files / 128 tests — finality timeline verified: justifiedHead 0→4 at slot 4, finalized 4 at slot 8, 8 at slot 12), npm run build exit 0. Decisions (discretion, no reference-type semantics change): SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4; checkpoint epoch derived from block slot; equivocation resolved lexicographically for determinism; delivery still instant/shared-view — T-005 introduces per-validator visibility on top of this driver. No blockers; no high-risk paths.

Executed batch T-005 (last of phase1-core). Introduced the message-visibility model: messages.ts (append-only MessageLog, every block/vote carries publishedAt), localView.ts (Delivery rule type with instantDelivery as the identity default; viewOf computes a validator's View as a pure filter over the log, holding back blocks whose parent is invisible together with their descendants; observe bundles view+finality+head per validator), and reworked simulation.ts so the proposer builds from its own view (slots < s), all attesters of a slot vote simultaneously (blocks ≤ s, votes ≤ s-1 — replaces the earlier sequential intra-slot attestation, making votes order-independent), and per-validator heads come from local views while tree/votes/finality remain the god view. Evidence: typecheck 0, test 0 (17 files / 138 tests — includes partition divergence within/across camps, post-heal convergence by slot 10, orphan exclusion, determinism under a custom delivery; the pre-existing finality-timeline and rewind tests pass unchanged), build 0. Decision: intra-slot attestation semantics changed from sequential to simultaneous — recorded as discretionary (no persisted scenarios exist; reference-type semantics untouched). completed_todos_since_reset reached the threshold (5): handoff written for a context reset; next session starts phase2-ui at T-006 from disk alone.
Context reset executed; counters zeroed.

Cycle 4 executed phase2-ui batch T-006+T-007 (both done with evidence). Removed all M1 code (src/core, src/protocol, src/setup.ts, old src/ui views/controls, 10 M1 test files, verify-visual.mjs) and built the replacement UI on src/domain only: App shell with chain/network/global mode tabs, slot bar (+1 advance, next-proposer display), validator count 4-10 selector (restarts scenario), theme toggle; chain mode with local (observe-based) / god perspective toggle, SVG block tree (slot columns, deterministic DFS row layout, J/F badges, head chips, vote-support chips), status panel and LMD latest-vote table; network/global modes are placeholders until T-008. README.md rewritten for the new design. Verification: typecheck 0, vitest 9 files / 67 tests 0 (incl. new jsdom DOM tests for the shell and chain mode, and treeLayout unit tests), vite build 0. Two environment dead ends recovered: sandbox denies port listen (EPERM) and cdn.playwright.dev, so the prepared real-browser smoke (scripts/verify-ui.mjs, file://-based) is deferred to a human-enabled run — recorded as Non-blocking Recommendation R-001 — and jsdom covers the same interactions headlessly (lesson L-20260827T233715+0900-c77c). Decisions within discretion: SVG rendering for the block tree (tech-stack discretion), salvaged M1's validated colour palette / theme system, jsdom as the autonomous UI-verification layer. No Essence reinterpretation; UI info-design choices stay within the first-build scope the Essence grants.
Context reset executed; counters zeroed.

T-008 done: network mode and global mode replace their placeholders. NetworkMode = per-validator card grid (head / justified head / finalized / latest vote incl. source→target) computed per validator with domain observe (pure filter over the message log); hover or keyboard focus shows that validator's local block tree below the grid via BlockTreeView; a card whose head disagrees with the majority head carries a 分岐中 text flag (colour never alone). GlobalMode = left ChainMode, right NetworkMode, both real components sharing App's perspective/validator-selection state, so every interaction works identically inside the split layout. README status/usage updated. Evidence: typecheck 0, vitest 9 files / 72 tests 0 (new jsdom DOM tests for card grid at 4 and 7 validators, hover-view swapping, global-layout interactions), vite build 0. Phase2-ui is now complete; next is phase3 (T-009 interventions, T-010 rewind UI).

T-009+T-010 done (phase3-interventions complete). Interventions are pure scenario data compiled onto the engine's two existing axes: compileDelivery (partition/delay/drop -> Delivery rule) and directivesForSlot (stop/double-propose/double-vote -> SlotDirectives); engine changes were compatible extensions only (Delivery gains a 5th MessageRef arg — 4-arg functions still conform; advanceSlot gains optional directives; stopped proposer leaves the slot empty). New domain files intervention.ts + scenario.ts (Scenario/scenarioStates = anchor recomputation shared by rewind and determinism). UI: InterventionPanel (partition checkboxes, stop/resume toggles, equivocation scheduling, per-message delay/drop with observer scoping, editable list whose 解消/削除 deterministically rewrites history), slot cursor rewind with truncate-on-advance-from-past, and all three modes now filter local views through the compiled delivery. Evidence: typecheck 0, vitest 11 files / 94 tests 0 (15 new domain intervention tests, 7 new DOM tests), build 0. One test-design catch: observe() defaults to instantDelivery, so intervention tests and UI local views MUST pass the scenario delivery explicitly — this is why ChainMode/NetworkMode grew a delivery prop.

Discretionary intervention semantics (first-build discretion; View/Vote types and the protocol skeleton untouched, so no Essence gate triggered): (1) partition delivery is monotone — a message reaches a cross-group observer iff some slot in [published, now] was unpartitioned, so pre-partition messages are through and healing releases everything held back; (2) stop silences (no propose/vote) but does not blind — the stopped validator keeps observing; (3) double propose = two sibling blocks on the same parent in one slot; (4) double vote = the honest vote plus a conflicting vote for the head's parent; (5) delay/drop never apply to the sender's own messages; (6) advancing from a past cursor truncates the discarded future (branch comparison is an explicit Essence non-goal), and editing/removing interventions deterministically rewrites displayed history — the tool is an understanding instrument, so history is a pure function of the scenario. These are candidates for human review if the Essence gains stricter semantics later.

T-011 done (phase4-scenario complete). Scenario persistence: src/domain/scenarioCodec.ts serializes {format, version, config (seed included), runSlot, interventions} and parseScenario validates the whole tagged union on load (unknown kinds, validator ranges, slot spans, partition-group duplication, message-ref shapes all rejected with specific messages) — a loaded scenario is as trustworthy as a built one. I/O stays in the UI layer: scenarioStore.ts (localStorage list; corrupt entries silently dropped so one bad record cannot brick the list) and ScenarioPanel.tsx (保存/読込・再実行/削除 + JSON export via Blob download / import via file input). useSimulation.loadScenario replays deterministically via scenarioStates and lands the cursor on the saved runSlot; App clamps selectedValidator for smaller loaded counts. Evidence: typecheck 0, vitest 13 files / 120 tests 0 (23 codec tests incl. replay-identity across all intervention kinds and 19 rejection cases; 3 DOM tests incl. save->mutate->reload exact reproduction), build 0. Success criterion 7 (保存・再読込・再実行で同一結果) is now covered end-to-end by tests at both layers.
Context reset executed; counters zeroed.

T-012 and T-013 done (phase5-polish complete) — all 13 must Todos are now done; the loop should stop at the must boundary for the human's phase decision. T-012 no-manual operability pass: intervention and scenario panels became collapsible <details> whose summaries always show the scheduled-intervention / saved-scenario counts, the delay/drop message selector groups the log per publish slot (newest first) so long runs stay readable, the equivocation legend gained the Japanese gloss（二重提案・二重投票）, and three empty states now explain the next step (no interventions yet / no saved scenarios yet / empty message log disables the selector with a hint); scenario status line got role=status. No look-and-feel pivot (Essence human-gate (b) not triggered). T-013 verification gate: typecheck 0, vitest 14 files / 126 tests 0 (6 new polish DOM tests), build 0; GitHub Pages path verified (vite base './', dist/index.html references only relative ./assets/… so the bundle serves from any subpath) and README gained a Pages deployment subsection — no .github/workflows added (high-risk zone; documentation only, Pages enablement is the human's repository setting). Validation initially warned that 成功条件 4 (post-heal convergence) mapped to no acceptance evidence; resolved by running the exact covering tests (tests/ui/interventions.test.tsx + tests/domain/localView.test.ts, 17 tests, exit 0) and recording a Japanese acceptance-evidence entry on T-013 — validation now ok with zero warnings.
